questions.q: Who surprised the Mole and the Rat by knocking at their door one summer morning?
choices: Mr. Badger
Toad
The Otter
A policeman

questions.q: What did the Badger mean when he said, "The hour has come!"?
choices: It was time to take Toad in hand and make him sensible
It was time for the boating season to begin
It was time for lunch
It was time to fight the weasels
questions.evidence: I said I would take him in hand as soon as the winter was well over

questions.q: What was waiting in front of Toad Hall when the three friends arrived?
choices: A shiny new bright red motor-car
A canary-yellow caravan
A new rowing boat
A police wagon
questions.evidence: painted a bright red (Toad's favourite colour)

questions.q: What did the Badger order first once they had Toad inside the hall?
choices: That Toad take off his ridiculous motor-clothes
That Toad be locked in the cellar
That Toad pay all his fines
That Toad sell his motor-cars
questions.evidence: first of all, take those ridiculous things off!

questions.q: What did the Badger say Toad was squandering?
choices: The money his father left him
The food in his larder
His friends' patience only
The Rat's boats
questions.evidence: squandering the money your father left you

questions.q: Why did the Rat say that talking to Toad would never cure him?
choices: Toad would say anything to please someone, without meaning it
Toad could not hear well
Toad never listened to Badger
Toad would fall asleep

questions.q: What did Toad say when the Badger asked him to repeat his promise in front of his friends?
choices: He was not sorry at all, and his driving had been glorious
He was very sorry and would never drive again
He would only drive slowly from now on
He would give his cars to the Badger
questions.evidence: I'm NOT sorry. And it wasn't folly at all! It was simply glorious!

questions.q: The Badger called Toad a "backsliding animal." What does "backsliding" mean here?
choices: Going back on a promise to behave better
Sliding down the stairs
Walking backwards
Getting stronger and braver

questions.q: What did the friends do after Toad refused to promise to give up motor-cars?
choices: Locked him in his bedroom and took turns guarding him
Sent him away to live with Badger
Took him to the police
Left him alone and went home
questions.evidence: lock him up in his bedroom

questions.q: What did Toad do with his bedroom chairs during his "paroxysms"?
choices: Arranged them like a motor-car and pretended to drive
Built a ladder to climb out the window
Threw them out the window
Broke them up to make a fire
questions.evidence: arrange bedroom chairs in rude resemblance of a motor-car

questions.q: What did the Badger warn the Rat about Toad being quiet and submissive?
choices: That is when Toad is at his most artful and up to something
It means Toad is finally cured
It means Toad is very ill
It means Toad wants to go boating

questions.q: Why did Toad ask the Rat to fetch both a doctor and a lawyer?
choices: To trick the Rat into leaving so he could escape
Because he was truly dying
Because he wanted to sue the Badger
Because he wanted to sell Toad Hall
questions.evidence: The Toad, who had hopped lightly out of bed as soon as he heard the key turned in the lock

questions.q: How did Toad escape from his locked bedroom?
choices: He knotted his bed-sheets into a rope and climbed out the window
He picked the lock with a hairpin
He crawled through a secret tunnel
He hid in the doctor's bag
questions.evidence: knotting the sheets from his bed together

questions.q: How did Toad feel about himself as he walked away from Toad Hall?
choices: Very pleased and conceited about his own cleverness
Guilty for tricking the Rat
Afraid of being caught
Sad to leave his friends
questions.evidence: he almost danced along the road in his satisfaction and conceit

questions.q: What was Toad doing at the Red Lion inn when he heard a motor-car arrive?
choices: Eating lunch in the coffee-room
Sleeping in a room upstairs
Paying for a room for the night
Reading a newspaper by the fire
questions.evidence: ordered the best luncheon that could be provided

questions.q: What excuse did Toad give himself for going out to the inn-yard?
choices: That there could be no harm in only just looking at the car
That he needed fresh air
That he wanted to find the stable-helps
That he had dropped his money there
questions.evidence: in my only just LOOKING at it!

questions.q: The Chairman calls Toad an "incorrigible rogue." What does "incorrigible" mean?
choices: Unable to be corrected or reformed
Very wealthy
Easily frightened
Polite and well-mannered
questions.evidence: the incorrigible rogue and hardened ruffian

questions.q: What is the result of Toad's love of motor-cars by the end of this chapter?
choices: He steals a car and is sentenced to twenty years in a dungeon
He becomes a famous racing driver
He finally gives up motor-cars for good
He buys a car and drives safely home
questions.evidence: It's going to be twenty years for you this time.
